spans.s: दिह् vt. 2U (pp. दिग्ध; pres. देग्धि, दिग्धे; desid. दिधिक्षति) 1. To anoint, to plaster, to smear, Bt.xvii.54; 2. to pollute, to soil, R.xvi.15.With सम्-, 1. to doubt, to be uncertain about, संदिग्धसाध्यवा पक्षः T.S.; 2. to raise an objection; 3. to mistake for, धूपैर्जालविनिःसृतैर्वलभयः संदिग्धपारावताः Vikr.iii., K.S.vi.40.
